categories.main_business_segments: DBG Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) sector, focusing on customized manufacturing of electronic products including consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets), automotive electronics, network communications, IoT devices, and new energy electronics. The company provides end-to-end services covering raw material procurement, new product introduction, assembly, testing, and logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced EMS manufacturing technologies with a strong emphasis on automation, intelligent manufacturing, and industrial internet integration. It utilizes state-of-the-art SMT equipment capable of handling ultra-fine pitch components, chip stacking, and automated assembly lines with extensive robotics. DBG invests heavily in R&D for process innovation such as automated testing for automotive T-BOX, optical inspection for smartphone cameras, IP68 waterproofing for consumer devices, and laser radar PCBA washing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DBG serves major global and domestic electronic brands and ODMs including Huawei, Xiaomi, Honor, Samsung, OPPO, and automotive suppliers like Valeo, Continental, and Denso. Its markets span consumer electronics, automotive electronics, network communications, IoT, and new energy sectors. The company also supports emerging Chinese new energy vehicle manufacturers and high-end ODM clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Huizhou, Shenzhen, Jiaxing, and overseas facilities in India, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Singapore, and Hong Kong. It is expanding its global footprint with acquisitions and new plants in Europe, America, and Africa, aiming for a dual domestic and international business cycle.
categories.supply_chain_position: DBG operates as a midstream EMS provider in the electronics supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly services. It procures raw materials both domestically and internationally, manages production, quality control, and logistics, serving downstream brand owners and ODMs without engaging in upstream raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes intelligent manufacturing upgrades, automation, and digitalization aligned with Industry 4.0. R&D focuses on process innovation, quality improvement, and new product development in automotive electronics, consumer electronics, and new energy sectors. DBG is expanding global manufacturing capacity and enhancing its engineering technology center to support advanced manufacturing and product reliability testing.
categories.revenue_model: DBG generates revenue primarily through direct sales of EMS manufacturing services, including customized product assembly and related value-added services. Revenue is derived from contracts with brand owners and ODMs, with sales split between domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DBG is a leading domestic EMS provider ranked 16th globally among EMS companies. It competes with large international EMS firms and local Chinese EMS enterprises, distinguished by its rapid market response, high operational efficiency, and comprehensive manufacturing capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, DBG reported revenue of approximately RMB 6.88 billion, a 27.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 275.67 million, reflecting a 30.52% decrease. The company has steadily expanded production capacity through multiple phases of smart manufacturing base construction and overseas acquisitions, maintaining a positive growth trajectory despite profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DBG emphasizes high-quality manufacturing with strict quality control certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO13485, etc.), fast market response, and advanced automation to meet diverse customer needs. Its global manufacturing footprint and ability to provide integrated EMS solutions from procurement to logistics differentiate it as a reliable partner for high-end consumer electronics and automotive electronics brands.
